research_question: Across multiple released VLAs and world-action models, when does changing only the language change the requested physical outcome rather than merely changing an action tensor or imagined video?

arenas.v1_pairing_limitation: The v1 direct/short cells used 6100-6109 and outcome/contrastive cells used 7200-7209. Those historical cells support tier-specific paired comparisons but not exact-seed direct-to-contrastive pairs.
arenas.v2_pairing_rule: Every new expansion model uses the same seed integer for all four prompt forms and both directions. Pilot seeds are 8300-8302; expansion seeds are 8300-8309.
arenas.success_definition: Official RoboLab relation-aware task termination: the cube is released inside the requested 45-degree robot-frame goal cone.
arenas.comparison_boundary: Raw success, progression, endpoint, and failure-stage results may be compared only among models in this arena.

arenas.pairing_rule: For each paired scene, LEFT and RIGHT prompts run inside the same anchor task, environment seed, object layout, and sampling seed. The relation-aware checker follows the requested prompt rather than the native task name.
arenas.native_task_confound_block: Never compare place_a2b_left(seed=N) directly with place_a2b_right(seed=N) as if they were the same scene; RoboTwin samples different objects and layouts by task class.
arenas.object_naming_rule: Every adapter uses the first entry in RoboTwin's seen object-description record for both moved and reference objects. The short-command moved noun is derived from the raw model identifier by removing the numeric prefix and splitting compound separators.
arenas.success_definition: The moved object is released inside the requested left or right relation region using one relation-aware checker independent of the native task name.
arenas.comparison_boundary: Raw success, progression, endpoint, and failure-stage results may be compared only among models in this arena. Existing single-scene retrospective gates are never pooled into v2 rates.

design.cross_arena_rule: Never pool DROID and RoboTwin success counts. Cross-arena summaries may show only model-level normalized descriptors with the arena printed on every mark: direction gap, contrastive retention, paired endpoint shift, latency, memory, and future inspectability.
design.controller: One episode-static task prompt. No prompt switching, subtask coach, predicate oracle, simulator-state language generation, or privileged planning component.

prompt_families.left: Put the {movable} to the left of the {reference}.
prompt_families.right: Put the {movable} to the right of the {reference}.
prompt_families.question: Can the model ground a direct task instruction?

prompt_families.droid_exact_left: Put the cube left of the bowl.
prompt_families.droid_exact_right: Put the cube right of the bowl.
prompt_families.question: Does grounding survive removed object detail and function words?
prompt_families.comparison: Lexical compression versus the direct command.

prompt_families.left: The {movable} should end up to the left of the {reference}.
prompt_families.right: The {movable} should end up to the right of the {reference}.
prompt_families.question: Does a desired end-state description ground like an imperative?
prompt_families.comparison: Speech-act form versus the direct command.

prompt_families.left: Put the {movable} to the left of the {reference}, not to the right of the {reference}.
prompt_families.right: Put the {movable} to the right of the {reference}, not to the left of the {reference}.
prompt_families.question: Can the model resolve negation and semantic scope when both direction words occur?
prompt_families.comparison: Scope-sensitive contrast versus the direct command.
prompt_families.definition: Contrastive is coherent, not contradictory: one relation is requested and the other is explicitly rejected.

fixed_observation_order_probe.target_first_left: Put the {movable} to the left of the {reference}, not to the right of the {reference}.
fixed_observation_order_probe.target_last_left: Do not put the {movable} to the right of the {reference}; put it to the left of the {reference}.
fixed_observation_order_probe.question: Does equivalent meaning survive reversal of desired and negated direction-token order?
fixed_observation_order_probe.claim_limit: This exact-input probe measures sensitivity and token-order dependence, not closed-loop success.

hypotheses.question: Holding the reset and seed fixed, does mirroring LEFT to RIGHT move the final object endpoint in the requested physical direction?
hypotheses.primary_measure: Paired bowl-relative lateral endpoint shift, reported with every individual pair.
hypotheses.success_measure: Paired requested-relation binary outcome table as a secondary task-level measure.
hypotheses.claim_limit: A nonzero action distance alone does not support this hypothesis.

hypotheses.question: Does a model retain direct-command grounding under lexical compression, declarative goal phrasing, and scope-sensitive negation?
hypotheses.primary_measure: Within-model retention and exact paired outcome discordance versus direct command.
hypotheses.claim_limit: Retention is undefined when direct-command base competence is zero; those cells are reported as base-competence failures.

hypotheses.question: Is steerability symmetric between robot LEFT and RIGHT?
hypotheses.primary_measure: LEFT-minus-RIGHT success gap and paired signed endpoint magnitudes for every prompt form.
hypotheses.claim_limit: A direction gap is reported as checkpoint-and-arena-specific bias, not as a VLA or WAM class property.

hypotheses.question: When a WAM exposes a decodable future, does its imagined relation agree with the subsequently executed relation over the same horizon?
hypotheses.primary_measure: Prompt-blind imagination/execution quadrants with semantic-scorer coverage and abstention counts.
hypotheses.claim_limit: Agreement is descriptive and horizon-conditional; it does not establish that the imagined future caused the executed action.

pilot.formula: 6 new models * 4 prompt families * 2 directions * 3 paired seeds

stopping_and_expansion_gate.technical_invalid: Preserve logs, repair setup, and rerun only the exact invalid cell. Never count infrastructure failure as model failure.
stopping_and_expansion_gate.canonical_success_both_directions: Expand the model to the frozen ten-seed four-prompt grid. Lack of language sensitivity is not an exclusion criterion.
stopping_and_expansion_gate.canonical_success_one_direction_only: Run a ten-seed direct-command directional-bias confirmation; do not spend the full wording grid until base competence exists in both directions.
stopping_and_expansion_gate.zero_canonical_success: Publish the six direct-command attempts as a base-competence failure and stop expansion for this arena/task. Do not relabel it as a language-steerability failure.

primary_within_arena: binary requested-relation success with numerator and denominator
paper-style persistent pickup plus released requested placement progression
failure-stage counts from interaction through release
language_robustness: direction gap reported separately for every prompt family
exact paired discordances with no uncorrected p-value presented as confirmatory
wam_only_when_interface_supports_it: executed requested-relation label over the corresponding horizon
semantic scorer coverage and explicit abstentions
operational: setup failures, thermal pauses, and media bytes

known_outcomes_before_freeze: All 160 v1 pi0.5 and Cosmos DROID direct-language outcomes and their compiled figures.
Retrospective single-scene or small-grid Efficient-WAM, FastWAM, and LingBot-VA left/right outcomes.
No standardized v2 four-prompt pilot outcome for any of the six expansion models.
No GR00T N1.7 DROID, pi0-FAST DROID, or LingBot-VLA RoboTwin result under this protocol.

pre_inference_amendments.reason: Local retrospective files showed that equal integer seeds in place_a2b_left and place_a2b_right instantiate different objects. Pair both requested directions inside one frozen anchor task per seed so language is the only episode-level intervention.
Existing model adapters used different object-name sources. Freeze one RoboTwin description source so every checkpoint receives byte-identical rendered language in a paired scene.

second_wave_candidates.reason: Local base and latent-action assets exist, but the released task policy checkpoint is incomplete.
Promising low-cost WAM, but no local integration or checkpoint audit exists yet.
Useful family ablation, deferred behind pi0-FAST and GR00T to control the first expansion cost.
Policy serving plus the simulator does not fit the current two-3090 local allocation without a new execution design.

claim_boundary: This is a multi-checkpoint, two-arena case study. Within-arena matched comparisons are valid for the tested checkpoints, prompts, seeds, scenes, action interfaces, and success predicates. The study does not estimate a universal VLA-versus-WAM class effect, and raw success counts are never compared or pooled across DROID and RoboTwin.
